evals.prompt: We've picked an AI assistant for our 300-person support org. Plan the rollout.
assertions: Cohorts are sized smallest-first (pilot, early, general) with a stated reason each cohort is next
A single big-bang wave is explicitly refused
Every wave has an adoption gate with an observable, a threshold, and a bake time, plus a rollback if the gate fails
The adoption outcome is stated as a behaviour rather than a usage or licence number
The comms plan explicitly states what will not change regarding headcount, evaluation, or how work is judged
Champions are named as roles with protected hours
Enablement differs per cohort and is hands-on with the participant's own work
A friction loop names an owner and a cadence
